# path | substring | reason
# A path ending in / covers its folder. A space in a substring matches any whitespace, so a hard wrap still matches.
# An entry clears only the words inside its substring, and an entry that clears nothing fails the contract test.

# Sentences saying Obsidian Git does it.
skills/ | Obsidian Git publishes | The standard report: Obsidian Git does it, not the agent.
skills/wiki-setup/references/initialization.md | Git's timer keeps committing them | Explains what Obsidian Git's timer does with per-machine files.
skills/wiki-setup/references/operation-recovery.md | Obsidian Git still publishes | Says Obsidian Git does it.
skills/wiki-setup/references/operation-recovery.md | ## Nothing is publishing | Heading for diagnosing Obsidian Git's timer.
skills/wiki-setup/references/operation-recovery.md | it publishes once the owner has | Says the work goes out by itself once the owner clears the cause.
skills/wiki-setup/references/operation-recovery.md | the plugin then publishes nothing | Describes Obsidian Git stopping on a conflict.
templates/vault-schema.md | Obsidian Git publishes | Says Obsidian Git does it.
scripts/init.mjs | a timer would keep publishing them | Comment init writes into .gitignore, about Obsidian Git's timer.
scripts/lib/prerequisites.mjs | Obsidian Git may be mid-sync | Says Obsidian Git is the one running.
scripts/purge.mjs | Obsidian Git publishes | What purge prints after it writes: Obsidian Git does it.
scripts/rename-unsafe-clippings.mjs | let Obsidian Git publish them | Advises waiting for Obsidian Git instead of a git step.
